text:
sam_sales: Quick sync  prospect PayFlux updated PQ. Key asks: dual HSM across regions, weekly rotation at 22:00 PST, no unwrapped keys in logs, and they listed "vendor Shamir" as preferred. Can we proceed with POC?
eli_se: We support BYO-HSM via proxy. We accept wrapped key blobs and can route signs to two HSM endpoints. Important: we DO NOT perform Shamir server-side. Customer must split client-side or via partner.
eli_se: Example POC snippet:
```
proxy_mode: accept-wrapped
primary: hsm-us-east:1234
secondary: hsm-us-west:1234
validate_wrapped: true
rotation: weekly@22:00-PST
```
nora_security: Security notes: 1) If they insist on vendor Shamir, mark as non-offered and propose partner-run split. 2) Require HSM vendor attestation (FIPS/module ID) before POC. 3) Logs may only contain digests/hashes, never wrapped plaintext. Retention >12 months needs legal/SOC2 addendum.
frank_sre: Perf note: cross-region HSM adds ~8-12ms; synchronous dual-sign raises p99. Onboarding checklist (POC): allowlist Redwood egress IPs, upload HSM certs, provide wrapped blobs, run rotation dry-run at 22:00 PST, configure SIEM for digests. Estimate: 2 SREs x 4 days + 1 security eng x 2 days.
sam_sales: Pricing: customer wants per-sign line. Propose reserved proxy + tiered per-1M sign ops + optional chaos/failover test as billable add-on. Use 3M ops/day for quote baseline.
deploy-bot: CI: byo-hsm-proxy v2.6 build queued -> https://ci.redwood/build/9911 :rocket:
sam_sales: Action items: Eli draft 2-week POC SOW with acceptance criteria (dual-sign failover, rotation dry-run, no-plaintext logs), Nora assemble vendor cert checklist, Frank confirm hours. I'll update RFQ and send to PayFlux. Thanks!
